manufacturer_report.body_en:
Dear Lenovo Support Team,

Device: Lenovo with NVIDIA GPU
Serial Number: {{SERIAL}}
Purchase Date: 2026-01

Issue: Recurrent unexpected reboots / blue screens attributed to graphics stack, persisting across driver versions.

Incident timeline (Windows Kernel-Power Event 41 + EventLog 6008):
- 2026-04-22: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, FAILURE_BUCKET 0x133_ISR_nvlddmkm!unknown_function, HASH {f97493a5-ea2b-23ca-a808-8602773c2a86}, Process Unity Hub.exe, SleepInProgress 0, driver timestamp unknown/null
- 2026-04-30: 0x0 NO_BLUE_SCREEN, no dump, SleepInProgress 4 (S4)
- 2026-07-17: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, same bucket/hash as above, Process System, SleepInProgress 1 (S1), driver timestamp 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-21: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, same bucket/hash, Process System, SleepInProgress 0, driver timestamp 2026-03-04
- 2026-07-24: 0x0 NO_BLUE_SCREEN, no dump, SleepInProgress 4 (S4)
- 2026-10-23: 0x116 VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, FAILURE_BUCKET 0x116_IMAGE_nvlddmkm.sys, HASH {c89bfe8c-ed39-f658-ef27-f2898997fdbd}, Process System, SleepInProgress 0, driver timestamp 2026-02-14

Analysis:
- Repetition: 4 incidents within 90 days (2026-04-22 to 2026-07-21), total 6 over ~185 days.
- Common module: 4/4 available dumps point to nvlddmkm.sys (NVIDIA graphics kernel driver). 3 share identical DPC watchdog ISR failure category; 1 is VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE category but same module.
- Persistence across driver versions: fails observed with driver timestamps 2026-03-04 and 2026-02-14 and one unknown build, indicating driver update alone did not resolve.
- Power transition: 3/6 with SleepInProgress !=0 (S1/S4) and 3/6 with 0, so issue occurs both during power transitions and normal operation.
- Other subsystems: Windows logs show no disk errors, no WHEA CPU/memory hardware errors, no repeated application failures, no CPU thermal throttling. GPU thermal/VRM not logged.

Responsible module: nvlddmkm.sys
Driver versions observed: timestamps 2026-02-14, 2026-03-04, plus one unknown. Exact version strings, VBIOS version, exact GPU model not available in current logs - pending collection.

Steps already taken:
- Issue observed to persist after driver version change (as per dump timestamps).
- Verified absence of disk, WHEA and CPU thermal events in logs.

Pending (requested by manufacturer typically):
- Clean install of Lenovo-recommended NVIDIA driver via DDU with version string
- BIOS/UEFI version check and update, chipset driver version
- Lenovo Vantage OEM diagnostics (GPU, VRAM, board), GPU-Z/HWInfo temperature, hotspot, power logs, NVIDIA bug report, stress results
- Full kernel dumps, System log nvlddmkm warnings Event 13/14, SleepStudy logs, sfc / DISM, PSU and PCIe reseat checks

Request: Please perform extended diagnostics focusing on GPU hardware/firmware interaction, VBIOS, power delivery and PCIe link stability, and verify if the failure reproduces on OEM recommended driver and clean OS. If hardware marginality is confirmed, please evaluate warranty repair/replacement.

Attachments: 4 minidumps and event logs available.

Regards.
manufacturer_report.body_es:
Estimado equipo de soporte Lenovo,

Equipo: Lenovo con GPU NVIDIA
Número de serie: {{SERIAL}}
Fecha de compra: 2026-01

Incidencia: Reinicios inesperados / pantallas azules recurrentes atribuidos al subsistema gráfico, que persisten tras cambios de driver.

Cronología (Eventos Kernel-Power 41 + EventLog 6008):
- 22-04-2026: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, bucket 0x133_ISR_nvlddmkm!unknown_function, hash {f97493a5-ea2b-23ca-a808-8602773c2a86}, proceso Unity Hub.exe, SleepInProgress 0, timestamp de driver desconocido
- 30-04-2026: 0x0 NO_BLUE_SCREEN, sin dump, SleepInProgress 4 (S4)
- 17-07-2026: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, mismo bucket/hash, proceso System, SleepInProgress 1 (S1), timestamp driver 2026-03-04
- 21-07-2026: 0x133 DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, mismo bucket/hash, proceso System, SleepInProgress 0, timestamp driver 2026-03-04
- 24-07-2026: 0x0 NO_BLUE_SCREEN, sin dump, SleepInProgress 4 (S4)
- 23-10-2026: 0x116 VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE, minidump -> nvlddmkm.sys, bucket 0x116_IMAGE_nvlddmkm.sys, hash {c89bfe8c-ed39-f658-ef27-f2898997fdbd}, proceso System, SleepInProgress 0, timestamp driver 2026-02-14

Análisis:
- Repetición: 4 incidencias en 90 días (22-04-2026 a 21-07-2026), total 6 en ~185 días.
- Módulo común: 4/4 dumps disponibles apuntan a nvlddmkm.sys (driver kernel gráfico NVIDIA). 3 comparten la misma categoría de fallo ISR DPC timeout; 1 es categoría distinta TDR pero mismo módulo.
- Persistencia entre versiones de driver: fallos con timestamps 2026-03-04 y 2026-02-14 y uno desconocido, por lo que una actualización no lo resolvió.
- Gestión de energía: 3/6 con SleepInProgress !=0 (S1/S4) y 3/6 con 0, ocurre tanto en transición de energía como en funcionamiento normal.
- Otros subsistemas: sin errores de disco, sin errores WHEA de CPU/memoria, sin fallos repetidos de aplicaciones, sin throttling de CPU por temperatura registrado. Termal de GPU no registrada.

Módulo responsable: nvlddmkm.sys
Versiones de driver observadas: timestamps 2026-02-14, 2026-03-04 y uno desconocido. Cadenas de versión exactas, versión VBIOS y modelo exacto de GPU pendientes de recogida.

Pasos ya realizados:
- Se observó persistencia tras cambio de versión de driver (según timestamps de dumps).
- Verificada ausencia de errores de disco, WHEA y throttling de CPU en logs.

Pendiente (normalmente solicitado por fabricante):
- Instalación limpia con DDU del driver NVIDIA recomendado por Lenovo con número de versión
- Versión de BIOS/UEFI y driver de chipset, actualización si procede
- Diagnósticos OEM Lenovo Vantage (GPU, VRAM, placa), logs GPU-Z/HWInfo de temperatura, hotspot, potencia, informe de bug NVIDIA, pruebas de estrés
- Dumps completos de kernel, logs de Sistema nvlddmkm Eventos 13/14, SleepStudy, sfc / DISM, verificación de PSU y reasentado PCIe

Solicitud: Por favor realizar diagnóstico ampliado centrado en hardware/firmware gráfico, VBIOS, entrega de potencia y estabilidad PCIe, y verificar si se reproduce con driver OEM recomendado y sistema limpio. Si se confirma marginalidad de hardware, por favor valorar reparación/reemplazo en garantía.

Adjuntos: 4 minidumps y logs de eventos disponibles.

Saludos.

manufacturer_report.body_en:
Dear Lenovo Support Team,

Device: Lenovo (exact model not captured in logs), Serial Number: {{SERIAL}}, Purchase Date: January 2026, GPU: NVIDIA.

Issue Summary: Recurring system instability - 6 unexpected reboots between 2026-04-22 and 2026-10-23 logged as Kernel-Power Event 41 and EventLog 6008.

Incident Timeline:
- 2026-04-22 inc-001: BSOD DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), dump module nvlddmkm.sys+e7703, driver timestamp null
- 2026-04-30 inc-002: Unexpected shutdown without BSOD (BugCheck 0x0), SleepInProgress=4, no dump
- 2026-07-17 inc-003: BSOD DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), nvlddmkm.sys+e7703, driver 2026-03-04, FAILURE_ID_HASH {f97493a5-ea2b-23ca-a808-8602773c2a86}, BUCKET 0x133_ISR_nvlddmkm!unknown_function
- 2026-07-21 inc-004: BSOD DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), nvlddmkm.sys+7e3b10, driver 2026-03-04, same hash as above
- 2026-07-24 inc-005: Unexpected shutdown without BSOD (0x0), SleepInProgress=4, no dump
- 2026-10-23 inc-006: BSOD VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x116), nvlddmkm.sys+19b1050, driver 2026-02-14, HASH {c89bfe8c-ed39-f658-ef27-f2898997fdbd}, BUCKET 0x116_IMAGE_nvlddmkm.sys

Responsible Module: nvlddmkm.sys (NVIDIA graphics) implicated in all 4 available dumps. Same FAILURE_ID_HASH repeated 3 times, indicating consistent failure category per rules engine.

Driver Versions: Failure observed with distinct driver timestamps 2026-02-14 and 2026-03-04 (and null for inc-001), showing persistence across driver versions.

Healthy Components (per logs): No disk errors, no WHEA memory/CPU hardware errors logged, no CPU thermal throttling, no repeated application failures.

Observations vs Hypotheses:
- Fact: 3/6 incidents occurred during power transition (SleepInProgress 1 in inc-003, 4 in inc-002/inc-005). Hypothesis: insufficient to prove power is root cause without additional WHEA/thermal/power logs.
- Hypothesis: Overall pattern points to NVIDIA graphics stack, but from minidumps alone cannot distinguish driver bug vs GPU hardware defect vs power delivery vs firmware.

Steps Already Taken/Observed: Driver version changed between incidents, but issue persisted. No documented clean install with DDU, no documented test with Lenovo OEM recommended driver, no documented GPU hardware diagnostics or BIOS version capture.

Request: Please perform diagnosis of GPU subsystem including GPU model/vBIOS verification, thermal/hotspot/VRAM/power rail logs, BIOS/UEFI version check, and evaluation for warranty repair/replacement if hardware fault confirmed. Pending information manufacturers usually require is listed in checklist.

Thank you.
manufacturer_report.body_es:
Estimado equipo de soporte de Lenovo,

Equipo: Lenovo (modelo exacto no capturado en logs), Numero de serie: {{SERIAL}}, Fecha de compra: enero de 2026, GPU: NVIDIA.

Resumen del problema: Inestabilidad recurrente con 6 reinicios inesperados entre 2026-04-22 y 2026-10-23 registrados como Kernel-Power 41 y EventLog 6008.

Cronologia:
- 2026-04-22 inc-001: Pantallazo azul DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), modulo nvlddmkm.sys, fecha de driver no disponible
- 2026-04-30 inc-002: Apagado inesperado sin pantallazo azul (0x0), SleepInProgress=4, sin dump
- 2026-07-17 inc-003: Pantallazo azul DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), nvlddmkm.sys, driver 2026-03-04, HASH {f97493a5-ea2b-23ca-a808-8602773c2a86}
- 2026-07-21 inc-004: Pantallazo azul DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION (0x133), nvlddmkm.sys, driver 2026-03-04, mismo hash
- 2026-07-24 inc-005: Apagado inesperado sin pantallazo azul (0x0), SleepInProgress=4
- 2026-10-23 inc-006: Pantallazo azul VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE (0x116), nvlddmkm.sys, driver 2026-02-14, HASH {c89bfe8c-ed39-f658-ef27-f2898997fdbd}

Modulo responsable: nvlddmkm.sys (graficos NVIDIA) implicado en los 4 dumps disponibles. Mismo FAILURE_ID_HASH repetido 3 veces indica misma categoria de fallo en este equipo.

Versiones de driver: El fallo persiste con dos marcas de tiempo distintas: 2026-02-14 y 2026-03-04 (null en inc-001), lo que sugiere que la actualizacion no resolvio el problema.

Componentes sanos segun logs: Sin errores de disco, sin errores WHEA de memoria/CPU, sin limitacion termica de CPU, sin fallos repetidos de aplicaciones.

Observaciones vs Hipotesis:
- Hecho: 3/6 incidentes ocurrieron en transicion de energia/suspension. Hipotesis: datos insuficientes para concluir que la energia es la causa raiz.
- Hipotesis: Patron apunta a pila grafica NVIDIA, pero solo con minidumps no se puede distinguir entre bug de driver, defecto de hardware GPU, alimentacion o firmware.

Pasos ya observados: Cambio de version de driver sin resolucion. No hay constancia de instalacion limpia con DDU, ni prueba con driver recomendado por Lenovo, ni diagnostico de hardware GPU ni version de BIOS.

Solicitud: Por favor realizar diagnostico completo del subsistema GPU incluyendo modelo/vBIOS, temperaturas/hotspot/VRAM/registros de alimentacion, revision de version BIOS/UEFI y valoracion de reparacion o reemplazo en garantia si se confirma fallo de hardware. La informacion pendiente habitualmente requerida esta en la checklist.

Gracias.
